platforms.scope: Default/all-feature tests, MSRV checks, packaging and owned PDF backend regressions
Core, MCP, persistence, reference CLI/stdio and full feature checks
Explicit frozen reference comparison with BGE-M3 and verified MiniLMv2 assets
No current CI validation claim; APIs may compile but require their own integration checks

adaptive.purpose: Explicit routing among registered retrieval sources.

advanced-search.purpose: Positional phrases and optional German stemming.

async.purpose: Enables the Tokio dependency; no separate async Engine API is selected.

bots.purpose: Alias enabling the optional web integration and its crawler.

cache.purpose: Rebuildable derived lexical and optional vector caches.

cli.purpose: Historical agent and training-file command-line tools.

colors.purpose: Retained empty feature flag; no standalone behavior is switched by this flag.

context-assembly.purpose: Bounded ranked context and explicit graph neighbors.

default.purpose: Lexical search, matching and relation suggestions.

disk-index.purpose: Own-format SQLite original records and full-text index.

documents.purpose: Immutable text revisions and checked UTF-8 source ranges.

embedded-knowledge.purpose: Explicitly embeds the sample training knowledge through build.rs.

embeddings.purpose: Provider-neutral validated vectors and exact cosine retrieval.

evidence-freshness.purpose: Explicit evidence revision and freshness assessments.

execution.purpose: Cooperative cancellation, monotonic deadlines and progress.

feedback.purpose: Explicit local feedback ledger and bounded preference adjustment.

hnsw.purpose: Explicit approximate vector retrieval with exact fallback.

hybrid.purpose: Reciprocal-rank fusion over lexical and exact semantic candidates.

learned-ranking.purpose: Explicit small linear ranker trained on supplied labels.

local-embeddings.purpose: Explicit verified local E5 ONNX adapter.

local-reranking.purpose: Explicit verified local multilingual MiniLMv2 ONNX adapter.

mcp.purpose: Bounded read-only local stdio transport with five tools.

pdf.purpose: Maintained bounded PDF import and supervised CLI path.

plotting.purpose: Retained empty feature flag; no standalone plotting API is switched by this flag.

provenance.purpose: Explicit shared source definitions and checked locations.

quality.purpose: Inspectable ranking metrics from supplied judgments.

quality-gates.purpose: Comparable runs and explicit quality/resource policies.

rank-explanations.purpose: Inspectable learned and feedback ranking contributions.

reasoning.purpose: Bounded explicit rule proposals and proof chains.

reranking.purpose: Provider-neutral scoring of actual candidate prefixes.

retrieval.purpose: Owned bounded excerpts, evidence and complete JSON.

shared-index.purpose: Shared immutable payloads across cloned indexes.

snapshots.purpose: Checked publication of coherent immutable dataset views.

storage.purpose: Atomic original-record batches, fenced revisions and pages.

training-pipeline.purpose: Explicit grouped training and evaluation orchestration.

versioning.purpose: Conflict-checked record revisions and bounded history.

web.purpose: Optional dashboard, HTTP/WebSocket, crawler and administration.

policy: Within the 0.5 line preserve public contracts and readable versioned formats. Feature isolation plus targeted interaction checks does not enumerate every possible subset. Native-model execution requires explicit assets and is separate from ordinary CI.
